excerpt.zh:
位于[From.GetName]几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
excerpt.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

texts.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the [From.GetName] is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionically-gifted population from the backlash of this event.
